@bibbymoynihan.bsky.social
I think you’re a hunk-a hunk-a burning shit.

Can we slow down a bit?

McDonald’s all-day breakfast lasted from 2015-2020. 2020 was also when Walmart stopped being 24 hours. 

Sierra Mist was discontinued in 2023. 

I know a lot changed with Covid but it was 6 years ago, not 50.

Pizza Hut buffets do seem ancient but those might be coming back!
This is the joke that was quite popular online and which Vulture/Splitsider called “inexcusable.” www.vulture.com/2012/03/snl-...

With the passing of Mr. Norris, I’m going to honor great American tradition by making it all about myself and sharing this image of the most successful of the five total jokes I wrote that got onto Weekend Update when I was a freelance joke submitter.

Chuck Norris didn’t die, he just finally defeated life. 

people.com/chuck-norris...
How did we all suddenly become okay with calling sauced food “wet”?
It’s kind of weird that the day after the Irish drinking holiday isn’t the one called Boxing Day.

It was only a few years ago that I learned that some people are very insistent that you spell it “St. Paddy’s Day” and not “St. Patty’s Day” and I was so excited to have something new to be pedantic about.

Somehow, it was decided that 5th graders at my kid’s school should wear their class t-shirts today which are GRAY. 

Admittedly, my town is more Italian Catholic than Irish Catholic, but, like, every other little league coach is named Michael Somethingirish. So I can’t be the only one grumbling.
￼Finally threw out my Christmas tree!

If a character dynamic doesn’t work for you that’s fine. But that may actually mean this particular piece of entertainment isn’t right for you, not that you are morally or intellectually superior to it.

What’s that? You think Dwight is more sympathetic than Jim? You understand that everyone who made the show wanted you to feel the other way but you’re a crazy maverick who manages to feel the opposite? 

Sounds like you’re more interested in patting yourself on the back than enjoying a TV show.

Hey, here’s some unsolicited advice: Usually the best way to enjoy and engage with a piece of entertainment is not to try to outsmart it. 

Not liking the main character who is supposed to be sympathetic does not mean you have DEFEATED the work of art, nor should that be your goal.
Maybe you should have bought an electric car. The Iran War is illustrating the cost of anti-EV nonsense.
Plentiful, high-paying jobs in the age of AI
AI has the worst sales pitch I've ever seen. "Our product will make you economically useless, and possibly kill you" is not a value proposition.
The economic consequences of the Iran war. The U.S. is likely to get off easy, while others will bear the brunt.
There isn't always a "long arc" of morality. Progressives should beware the idea that history will deliver them inevitable victories.
A conversation with Claude. In which a robot and I have a fun dorm-room chat about the future of science.
China is quietly looking weaker. Xi Jinping's paranoia, rapidly changing technology, and the limitations of China's system could cut short the Chinese Century.
